inference.reason: Adjacent 40-day cuts overlap heavily, and a single-school baseline can drift with calendar time, menus, and attendance; these are dependent descriptive contrasts, not an independent null distribution or causal p-value.

quality.missing_pw_rule: PW kg is required by the pinned reader; a missing PW value rejects the workbook before this analysis

rules.candidate_cutoffs: every split with 20 recorded baseline observations before and 20 after, in worksheet/date order; adjacent observations need not be consecutive calendar dates
rules.complete_case: include a cutoff only when all 40 observations have KSW kg; PW, KSW, and total then use identical days and diner denominators
rules.delta: after minus before in g per diner; compare unrounded Decimal deltas with final 20 minus latest complete baseline 20, then round displayed values to six places
rules.estimator: 1000 * sum(component kg) / sum(diners) on eligible days; Decimal arithmetic, six-place half-even output
